topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000000088: no pseudo-Anosov stretch factor is rational
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture88 concerns irrationality of pseudo-Anosov stretch factors and unimodular integer eigenvalues. Its repaired two-by-two Perron examples concern mapping classes, not a smallest positive second-eigenvalue ratio for all primitive substitutions.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000001260 (factor complexity of substitutive words)
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture1260 is about factor complexity of primitive substitutive words, using Thue–Morse and Tribonacci. It does not assert or refute a minimum spectral ratio, an algebraic degree of that ratio, or the trace-error criterion in7718.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of 00000003423: adding edge {1,3} increases H(1->2) from 1 to 2
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture3423 concerns graph random-walk hitting-time monotonicity under edge addition; substitution means inserting a proposed scalar solution. The sole maintainer comment rejects missing graph/walk formalization and does not discuss substitution tilings.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000004340 (symmetric measures: odd moments all zero — no separation)
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture4340 concerns vanishing odd moments of centrally symmetric measures; substitution means the integration change x↦−x. The sole maintainer comment rejects missing measure/moment formalization. No substitution word system or spectral ratio occurs.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000000420: the proposed density has mass greater than one
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture420 concerns total mass of an angular density and impossibility of a probability limit; substitution refers to a change of integration variable.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000001259 via the Tribonacci matrix discriminant
topic_classifications.reason: Our accepted conjecture1259 contribution concerns the Tribonacci matrix having non-real characteristic roots; it refutes an explicit three-real-eigenvalues assertion and does not solve the different sharp trace-error/spectral-ratio minimum criterion in7718.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000009761: a 2-by-2 matrix violates the arithmetic Weyl bound
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture9761 concerns an arithmetic Weyl inequality relating matrix eigenvalues and singular values; its second-eigenvalue modulus is not a substitution spectral ratio or positive minimum.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000003315: a toric cubic with no quadratic binomial generators
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture3315 concerns toric ideals and absence of quadratic binomial generators; substitution is monomial evaluation under an algebra homomorphism.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove 00000007174: a scaled rotation violates the condition-number lower bound
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture7174 concerns a condition-number lower bound involving an antisymmetric matrix part. The spectral ratio of a scaled rotation is unrelated to positive primitive substitution matrices or a three-letter minimum.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove 00000006069: variable-only MGUs violate the proposed depth bound
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture6069 concerns most-general unifiers and variable-image depths; first-order term substitution is a different mathematical object.

topic_classifications.title: Disproof of conjecture 00000000297 (no aperiodic set of two Wang tiles)
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture297 concerns minimum size of an aperiodic Wang tile set and periodic realizations for two tiles; no primitive substitution matrix eigenvalue-ratio claim.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove conjecture 00000009611: two cubic Perron numbers with minimal matrix sizes 3 and 4
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture9611 concerns the minimal matrix realization size of cubic Perron numbers. Its degree/trace obstruction and positive Perron eigenvector discussion do not address minimum second-to-Perron spectral ratios for three-letter primitive substitutions.

topic_classifications.title: Disprove 00000007857: complete graphs contradict the displayed gap scale
topic_classifications.reason: Conjecture7857 concerns normalized-Laplacian/lazy-walk spectral-gap scaling for Erdős–Rényi complete graphs; no substitution-system spectral ratio minimum.
